Now that ApeSTR is effectively bricked and can't resell apes, people have been asking if they can swap for apes in the pool, so I built a tool to do just that.

Live now at https://t.co/Pnk9kD2NMd

Works for apes, pudgys, CDBs, meebits, moonbirds and cryptoadz. Squigs are there too but that contract does not hold any squigs anymore, so no real opportunities to swap.

Note that you'll need 2 of a given NFT to swap for a new one. One is used as the "bait" and returned to you after the swap.

Tomorrow, @Rhynotic will gift bait NFTs to the contract so that swappers do not need to provide one themselves. It will also be added to the NFTStrategy frontend (I think).

There is a small fee, half of which goes towards buying and burning the strategy tokens.

Note: the tool also supports the 10 BAYC that are in the BAYCExchange contract by @machibigbrother, and those do not require bait NFTs at all.

Happy swapping.
